Wide,Ⓒa.ⒹvistIrRa, viSAla, uru, vipula, pfTu; See Broad; ‘w(ide) of the mark’ lakzyaBrazwa-cyuta, aprAstAvika (kI f.).
Ⓝ[Wide]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹvipulaM, sarvatra, su-ati-bahu pr., ‘w(idely) known’ suviKyAta, ‘w(idely) awake’ suprabudDa; ‘with eyes w(idely) open’ utPullanayana.
Ⓝ[Wid]en,Ⓒv. t.ⒹpfTUkf 8 U, viSAlIkf, praT 10.
ⓃWidth,Ⓒs.ⒹvistAraH, vyAsaH, pariRAhaH, viSAlatA.

Widow,Ⓒs.ⒹviDavA, a-gata-BartfkA, viSvastA, anATA, raMqA; ‘child-w(idow)’ bAlaviDavA.

Ⓝ[Widow]er,Ⓒs.ⒹmftapatnIkaH, gataBAryaH.
